g1.label: 1. Where does Jake live?
g1.why: The text says Jake lives in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

g2.label: 2. How does Jake get to school?
g2.why: The text says Jake takes the school bus to school.

g3.label: 3. What is Jake’s favourite subject?
g3.why: The text says Jake’s favourite subject is science.

g4.label: 4. What does the family eat at Thanksgiving?
g4.why: The text says the family eats turkey with mashed potatoes at Thanksgiving.

g5.label: 5. What is Jake thankful for?
g5.why: The text says Jake is thankful for his dog, Buddy.

g6.label: 6. What does the family do at the lake in summer?
g6.why: The text says the family goes swimming and has barbecues at the lake in summer.

g1.label: 1. Jake ___ to school at 7:30 (go)
g1.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Jake goes.

g2.label: 2. His school day ___ at 2:30 (finish)
g2.why: Verbs ending in -sh add ‘-es’ in the simple present: finishes.

g3.label: 3. Jake and his friends ___ basketball (play)
g3.why: ‘Jake and his friends’ is a plural subject, so it takes the base form ‘play’.

g4.label: 4. His mum ___ a big turkey (cook)
g4.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: mum cooks.

g5.label: 5. The family ___ to the lake (drive)
g5.why: ‘The family’ is treated here as a group of people, so it takes the base form ‘drive’.

g6.label: 6. Jake ___ science (like)
g6.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Jake likes.

g7.label: 7. The students ___ English, maths and art (study)
g7.why: ‘The students’ is a plural subject, so it takes the base form ‘study’.

g8.label: 8. Jake’s dog Buddy ___ in the garden (run)
g8.why: He/she/it in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Buddy runs.

g1.label: 1. Jake’s mum ___ the turkey (prepare)
g1.why: A singular subject (mum) takes ‘is’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g2.label: 2. Jake and his brother ___ the table (set)
g2.why: A plural subject takes ‘are’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g3.label: 3. Grandma ___ pumpkin pie (bake)
g3.why: A singular subject (Grandma) takes ‘is’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g4.label: 4. The cousins ___ a football game (watch)
g4.why: A plural subject (the cousins) takes ‘are’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g5.label: 5. Dad ___ with Uncle Tom (talk)
g5.why: A singular subject (Dad) takes ‘is’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g6.label: 6. Buddy the dog ___ under the table (sleep)
g6.why: A singular subject (Buddy) takes ‘is’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g7.label: 7. Jake ___ cranberry sauce (put)
g7.why: A singular subject (Jake) takes ‘is’ + verb-ing in the present progressive.

g8.label: 8. Everyone ___ (smile)
g8.why: ‘Everyone’ is grammatically singular, so it takes ‘is’ + verb-ing, not ‘are’.
